payload.answer: Panel after reload, Status follows tests, Proof survives renumber

options.description: A panel started by a plugin reload takes over a slot silent for over a minute, and retries for about 80 s after a refusal. Caveat: the heartbeat is only refreshed when a turn starts, so after a minute idle a second panel could take over a live one.
options.label: Panel after reload

options.description: The real cause was old test variants recorded as failing on 18 Oct and never run again. A newer run of the same test now replaces them. Caveat: running a single variant by hand could hide an older failure of another variant.
options.label: Status follows tests

options.description: A proof you confirmed still counts after its record gets a new number, while its words are unchanged. Caveat: no requirement states this yet, so it is tied to the merge-hold requirement (SR-260).
options.label: Proof survives renumber

payload.question: Three fixes passed their tests and an independent review. Which shall I land in main now? The background-fixer fix is still being reviewed and will be asked separately.
